description: This Java class defines an EnforcementTask used within a system to schedule and execute enforcement actions related to entities, with support for asynchronous execution and authorization change tracking.

classes.name: EnforcementTask
classes.description: A class representing a scheduled enforcement task that can be executed asynchronously, holding contextual information about an entity and whether the enforcement changes authorization.

methods.name: EnforcementTask.of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an EnforcementTask with a supplier that produces a CompletionStage of Contextual data, with internal casting to handle covariant types.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the EntityId associated with this enforcement task.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether executing this enforcement task will change authorization for subsequent signals.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins executing the enforcement task by invoking the supplier, returning a CompletionStage with the contextual result.
